hero.body: Handcrafted silver deity statues, gemstone necklaces, and ceremonial artifacts - each piece a living bridge between ancient tradition and enduring beauty.

categories.label: Silver Idols
categories.title: Deity Statues
categories.desc: Hand-carved silver icons of the divine - Ganesha, Lakshmi, Durga, Buddha - in 92.5 and fine silver.

categories.label: Necklaces
categories.title: Gemstone Jewellery
categories.desc: Gold-plated sterling silver necklaces adorned with lapis lazuli, coral, turquoise, and pearl.

categories.label: Artifacts
categories.title: Cultural Artifacts
categories.desc: Ceremonial bowls, incense holders, filigree boxes - expressions of Himalayan metalwork tradition.

heritage.imageAlt: Master artisan at work in Patan workshop
heritage.body1: For over thirty-five years, master artisan Ram Prasad Sharma has maintained the ancient repoussé and filigree traditions of Patan - one of the world's oldest centres of metalworking excellence.
heritage.body2: Our pieces travel from this storied valley to collections in Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia, carrying with them the spiritual weight and aesthetic mastery of a living craft tradition.

process.title: Pure Materials
process.desc: 92.5 sterling silver and 999 fine silver, sourced responsibly from certified suppliers.

process.title: Hand-Crafted
process.desc: Every piece shaped, carved, and finished entirely by hand using traditional tools and techniques.

process.title: Precious Stones
process.desc: Naturally sourced lapis lazuli, coral, turquoise, ruby, and sapphire, individually selected.

process.title: International Delivery
process.desc: Insured worldwide shipping with discreet, custom packaging to preserve each piece in transit.
